description: Coordinate-free Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Maps, and Android system navigation cases derived from primary Google Help documentation. Routes model documented semantic controls and prerequisites, not pixel coordinates or a promise that every OEM skin uses the same wording.
review_policy: Use primary publisher documentation only. Re-review source-linked cases when an official page changes, an Android platform requirement changes, or a device capture contradicts a semantic route. Preserve old frozen versions and publish a versioned replacement. Never convert documented order into guessed coordinates. Stop or no-click before any setting change, transmission, deletion, sharing, emergency action, or sensitive-data reveal.
identifier_policy: com.android.settings and Google application packages identify documented products; documented.google.personal_safety is a stable dataset identifier and is not an Android package-name claim.
